ghosttype.preset.0: Open a window in the morning and the air smells unlike yesterday. Seasons turn without a sound.
ghosttype.preset.1: Take the long way round is not an excuse for being slow; it is what people who walked far already know.
ghosttype.preset.2: Cats love boxes. The smaller the box, the more they love it. Nobody knows why.
ghosttype.preset.3: The smell of a rainy day has a name. It is the breath the soil held in for too long.
ghosttype.preset.4: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the whole town is asleep.
